newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 2.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

The former Conservative minister Neil Hamilton has admitted that he took payments totalling 10,000 stg from the parliamentary lobbyist Ian Greer, and that he did not tell Michael Heseltine about it when he was asked.
500 STG WINDFALLS IN NORWICH FLOAT PLAN
Investors and policyholders in Norwich Union will receive average windfalls of 500 stg when the society floats on the stock market next summer.
A record eight million stg was raised from new stock market issues in the first nine months of 1996, according to KPMG Corporate Finance.

Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell think the German telecommunications giant Deutsche Telekom, which is due to privatise next month, could reduce its huge debts of 100 billion marks (42 billion stg) by a third over the next four years.
REGENT VOTE THREAT ON HAMBRO BREAK-UP

Hong Kong-based Regent Pacific, which is trying to break up Hambros is threatening to call an extraordinary general meeting of the bank to vote on its dismemberment proposals, unless Hambros begins to implement them in the next three weeks.
